name: dsfd_engram_sink_m5-m5-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed engram-sink-pin-e5c627229-tt (dsfd_engram_sink, RTL e5c627229): same RTL, outline 360.0x135.0, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Codex:engram

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_engram_sink #(.PIN_CAPTURE(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/engram/dsfd_engram_sink.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_engram_gather.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/engram/ot_dsrom_engram_rowsink.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_engram_sink_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_engram_sink_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_engram_sink_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_engram_sink  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
